# rintup_alert_channel (Resource)

A notification channel in a contact group (e-mail, SMS, webhook, Slack, Discord, Telegram, Teams, PagerDuty, Opsgenie). The API cannot change a channel, so any change replaces it. E-mail and SMS channels start unverified: the target receives a verification link or code.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# rintup_contact_group.ops: see the rintup_contact_group example.

# E-mail: a plain target. The address receives a verification link first.
resource "rintup_alert_channel" "email" {
  contact_group_id = rintup_contact_group.ops.id
  type             = "email"
  target           = "ops@example.com"
  locale           = "tr"
}

# Slack: the incoming webhook URL is a credential, so it goes to the write-only target_wo.
variable "slack_webhook_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "rintup_alert_channel" "slack" {
  contact_group_id  = rintup_contact_group.ops.id
  type              = "slack"
  target_wo         = var.slack_webhook_url
  target_wo_version = "1" # bump after rotating the webhook: the channel is recreated
}

# Webhook with your own signing key (write-only). Without secret_wo the server generates one and
# returns it once; the provider then keeps it in the sensitive generated_secret attribute.
variable "webhook_signing_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "rintup_alert_channel" "webhook" {
  contact_group_id  = rintup_contact_group.ops.id
  type              = "webhook"
  target            = "https://hooks.example.com/rintup"
  secret_wo         = var.webhook_signing_key
  secret_wo_version = "1"
}

# PagerDuty: the Events API v2 routing key is the secret.
variable "pagerduty_routing_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "rintup_alert_channel" "pagerduty" {
  contact_group_id  = rintup_contact_group.ops.id
  type              = "pagerduty"
  secret_wo         = var.pagerduty_routing_key
  secret_wo_version = "1"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `contact_group_id` (String) The `rintup_contact_group` this channel belongs to.
- `type` (String) `email`, `sms`, `webhook`, `slack`, `discord`, `telegram`, `teams`, `pagerduty` or `opsgenie`.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `locale` (String) Notification language: `en` or `tr`. Default: `en`.
- `secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Webhook signing key, Telegram bot token, PagerDuty routing key or Opsgenie API key. Write-only: never stored in state. Change `secret_wo_version` to send a new value (replaces the channel).
- `secret_wo_version` (String) Any value; when it changes the channel is recreated with the current `secret_wo`.
- `target` (String) Non-secret target: e-mail address, phone number (E.164 or TR national), Telegram chat id, Opsgenie region (`us`/`eu`). For webhook URLs that act as credentials (Slack, Discord, Teams) use `target_wo`.
- `target_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret target, e.g. a Slack/Discord/Teams incoming webhook URL. Write-only: never stored in state. Change `target_wo_version` to send a new value (replaces the channel).
- `target_wo_version` (String) Any value; when it changes the channel is recreated with the current `target_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `display` (String) Masked target as the API shows it.
- `generated_secret` (String, Sensitive) Webhook channels without `secret_wo`: the signing key the server generated. The API returns it only once, so it is kept in state (sensitive). Set `secret_wo` to keep state free of it.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `requires_verification` (Boolean)
- `verified` (Boolean) E-mail/SMS: the target was verified. Other types: a notification reached it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# "<contact_group_id>/<channel_id>" (fast) or just "<channel_id>" (all groups are searched).
# The API never returns a channel's target, secret or locale: after an import the first apply
# adopts them from the configuration without recreating the channel.
terraform import rintup_alert_channel.slack 0192f3a4-0000-7000-8000-000000000001/0192f3a4-0000-7000-8000-000000000002
```
